context: Placeholder text in a search field that enables users to search for collections and their callbacks by name. When text is entered here, the plugin only shows collections and callbacks whose name contains that text.

The number of instances in an active collection is shown as "XXX inst", where 'inst' is an abbreviation for 'instance'. Example: "5 inst". There is very little space, so the abbreviation should most likely be 4-5 characters or less.
A message that is shown in the panel when the scripts haven't defined any collections or the experience isn't running
Tooltip that describes what the plugin does. (It inspects collections, which are currently in Studio Beta: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/studio-beta-collections/4809228)
The name of the plugin, and also the name of the feature it is associated with. See https://devforum.roblox.com/t/studio-beta-collections/4809228 for details.
